list.title: Evals
list.intro: An eval case is a task for the built-in AI with checks of what must be true afterwards. An eval run replays cases across different models, reasoning levels, or providers and puts results side by side, instead of relying on a hunch.
list.casesEmptyDescription: Create a case, or save a real run as a case in the run inspector.
list.runsEmptyDescription: An eval run replays cases across the models you want to compare.
list.checksCount: {invariants, plural, one {# invariant} other {# invariants}}, {criteria, plural, one {# criterion} other {# criteria}}
list.runShape: {cases, plural, one {# case} other {# cases}} × {variants, plural, one {# variant} other {# variants}} × {repetitions}
list.violatedCount: {count, plural, one {# invariant violated} other {# invariants violated}}

modeHint.read_only: The run operates on the real pages and must not change or propose anything.
modeHint.propose: The run may propose changes. Proposals are kept as evidence, rejected at the end, and never applied.
modeHint.fixture: The pages of the case are copied to a sandbox for each attempt. The run may only write there, and sees nothing outside of it. The sandbox is deleted afterwards.

summary.answer_matches: The pattern {pattern} appears in the answer: at least {min}, at most {max}.
summary.tool_called: {tool} is called: at least {min}, at most {max}.
summary.no_changes: Changes nothing: no suggestion, no modified page, and no new page.
summary.page_excludes: The page “{page}” afterwards does not contain “{text}”.
summary.pages_created: New pages: at least {min}, at most {max}.
summary.proposed_changes: Proposed changes: at least {min}, at most {max}.

dialog.description: What the AI should do, where, under what limits, and what must hold afterwards. Changes bump the version; earlier attempts keep the version they were evaluated against.

problems.name: The case needs a name.
problems.pages: Each custom page needs a unique key and a title.
problems.checks: A check is incomplete, duplicate, or doesn’t match the mode.
problems.limits: Budget, tool iterations, and run time must be numbers.

dialog.expectedPlaceholder: In words for grading, for example: at most eight work packages, each with a file.
dialog.promptPlaceholder: Exactly as given to the AI.
dialog.startPageNone: None: the run is not on any page.
dialog.invariantsHint: If one is violated, the attempt fails no matter how the rest turns out.
dialog.criteriaHint: What success means. All must be met; a human decides manual checks during grading.
dialog.noChangesHint: No suggestion, no modified custom page, and no new page in the sandbox.
dialog.fixtureHint: These pages are copied fresh into a sandbox for each attempt. The key is the name checks use to reference a page.

start.title: Start eval
start.description: Each combination of case, variant, and repetition is a separate, paid run of the built-in AI.
start.total: {count, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}}, at most {max}
start.variantsHint: A model with a reasoning level, optionally restricted to specific providers. The label is the column header in the comparison.
